entities.summary: Georgina Theodora Wood is a Ghanaian former judge and a former public prosecutor of the Ghana Police Service. She is the first female to serve in the office as Chief Justice of Ghana. She retired in 2017 after five decades of service to the state. She is a member of the Council of State. Georgina Theodora Wood was a legal figures from Ghana (b. 1947-06-08, Ghana). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
